record-classes.title: Record classes
record-classes.summary: Use records to define concise value-like data types.
record-classes.why: A record declares its state components and automatically provides a constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString.
record-classes.tips: Records fit value-like data. Prefer a regular class when the model needs mutable state or a more complex inheritance design.

sealed-type-hierarchy.title: Sealed type hierarchies
sealed-type-hierarchy.short: Restrict which types may extend or implement a type
sealed-type-hierarchy.summary: Close a type hierarchy with sealed and permits.
sealed-type-hierarchy.why: A sealed type can explicitly limit its permitted direct subclasses or implementations.
sealed-type-hierarchy.tips: Use sealed hierarchies when the set of variants is intentionally closed. Permitted subclasses must declare final, sealed, or non-sealed.

files-read-text-utf8.title: Read a UTF-8 file as a string
files-read-text-utf8.short: Use Files.readString with an explicit charset
files-read-text-utf8.summary: Read a UTF-8 text file in one call with Files.readString.
files-read-text-utf8.why: Files.readString provides a concise way to read an entire text file into a String and can make the expected Charset explicit.
files-read-text-utf8.tips: For very large files, avoid loading everything into memory and process the input incrementally with a reader.

stream-to-unmodifiable-list.title: Convert a Stream to an unmodifiable List
stream-to-unmodifiable-list.summary: Use Stream.toList to obtain an unmodifiable List.
stream-to-unmodifiable-list.why: Since Java 16, Stream.toList() provides a concise way to gather stream elements into a List.
stream-to-unmodifiable-list.tips: The returned List is unmodifiable. Use a collector or another approach when a mutable List is required.

concurrent-modification-during-foreach.title: ConcurrentModificationException during for-each
concurrent-modification-during-foreach.short: A collection was structurally modified during traversal
concurrent-modification-during-foreach.summary: Avoid unsafe structural modification while traversing a collection.
concurrent-modification-during-foreach.why: Directly changing a collection while an enhanced for loop or iterator is traversing it can be detected as an invalid structural modification.
concurrent-modification-during-foreach.tips: Use removeIf for conditional removal, or Iterator.remove when removing through an iterator.

parse-int-invalid-input.title: NumberFormatException from parseInt
parse-int-invalid-input.short: A non-integer string was passed to Integer.parseInt
parse-int-invalid-input.summary: Handle invalid integer text passed to Integer.parseInt.
parse-int-invalid-input.why: Integer.parseInt throws NumberFormatException when the input cannot be interpreted as an integer.
parse-int-invalid-input.tips: Validate external input and handle parsing failures where malformed data is expected.

checked-exception-must-be-caught.title: Checked exception must be caught or declared
checked-exception-must-be-caught.short: A checked exception is neither handled nor declared
checked-exception-must-be-caught.summary: Checked exceptions must be caught or declared with throws.
checked-exception-must-be-caught.why: Operations that can throw checked exceptions such as IOException require the caller to catch them or declare them with throws.
checked-exception-must-be-caught.tips: Catch an exception where recovery is meaningful; otherwise declare it so a higher layer can decide how to handle it.

instance-field-from-static-context.title: Accessing an instance field from static context
instance-field-from-static-context.short: Instance state was referenced directly from static code
instance-field-from-static-context.summary: Distinguish instance state from static context.
instance-field-from-static-context.why: A static method has no particular this instance, so it cannot access an instance field by name alone.
instance-field-from-static-context.tips: Make behavior instance-based when it depends on object state, or explicitly provide the instance whose state should be read.

generic-cast-runtime-type-warning.title: Unchecked generic cast warning
generic-cast-runtime-type-warning.short: A generic cast cannot be fully verified at runtime
generic-cast-runtime-type-warning.summary: Understand unchecked generic casts caused by type erasure.
generic-cast-runtime-type-warning.why: Because of type erasure, a runtime cast cannot fully verify type arguments such as the String part of List<String>.
generic-cast-runtime-type-warning.tips: Do not merely suppress the warning. Validate element types at the boundary and convert data into a type-safe representation.

hashmap-mutable-key-lookup.title: HashMap lookup with a mutable key
hashmap-mutable-key-lookup.short: Changing state used by hashCode can make a key unreachable
hashmap-mutable-key-lookup.summary: Keep HashMap keys stable after insertion.
hashmap-mutable-key-lookup.why: HashMap places entries using the key's hash. If state involved in hashCode or equals changes after insertion, lookup can fail even with the same object.
hashmap-mutable-key-lookup.tips: Use immutable value objects as map keys and never mutate state that participates in equality after insertion.
